title: Offset Launches NEED FM Hotline for Fans to Call Him for Relationship, Life Advice — But He Has 1 Rule
summary: The rapper kicks off a new solo era on Sept. 18 with his "Something I Need" single.
contentText:
Offset wants to hear from you. The Migos rapper launched his late-night NEED FM hotline for fans to give him a call on Tuesday (Sept. 15) and get whatever they need to off their chests.

The phone lines are now open. Just hit Offset at 470-742-6949 and he’ll return your call with a message about whatever life advice he thinks could be useful, ranging from relationships to getting your money up.

“Call a player and tell me what ya need. Some of y’all need closure, some of y’all need some answers and some of y’all just need somebody to tell y’all what really going on,” Set said. “You got some s–t on your mind, call me.”

The Atlanta native just has one rule on NEED FM: “Just don’t call up here with all that cap, man!”

Offset is gearing up for a new solo era of music on Friday (Sept. 18), which will welcome the release of his “Something I Need” single.

He’s been teasing the track by revealing the cover art — which finds him in the water hugging on a woman — and a nautical-themed clip partying on a yacht. “SHE AIN’T MINE… JUST SOMETHING I NEED,” he wrote on IG.

Offset’s last solo album came with Kiari in September 2025, which debuted at No. 16 on the  Billboard 200.  Following his next project that appears to be imminent, look for Set and Quavo to reunite for one more Migos album  and another tour together.

Quavo spoke with  V-103’s DJ Greg Street  earlier in September, during which he revealed that plans for the Migos are in motion. A final Migos album will feature posthumous vocals from their late member Takeoff,  who was fatally shot in Houston in November 2022.

“We coming back. We’re going to do it one more time,” Quavo said. “Long live the Rocket … There’s more. We going to tour. We going to do it right.”
